disclaimer: EXPLORATORY SENSITIVITY SCENARIOS — Alternative weight configurations represent hypothetical operational priorities to test ranking stability. They are NOT scientifically validated, empirical, or predictive models of flood damage or casualty risk.

scenarios.description: Equal weight distribution across all four primary risk components.
scenarios.assumptions: Exploratory neutral baseline assuming no single risk component has operational priority.

scenarios.description: High building exposure weighting prioritizing structural vulnerability.
scenarios.assumptions: Exploratory scenario simulating urban search-and-rescue where structural density dominates dispatch.

scenarios.description: High flood coverage weighting prioritizing relative inundated zone percentage.
scenarios.assumptions: Exploratory scenario simulating wide-area flood monitoring where zone saturation drives emergency declarations.

scenarios.description: High road isolation weighting prioritizing cut-off and inaccessible zones.
scenarios.assumptions: Exploratory scenario simulating access-constrained operations where road blockages require specialized air or boat assets.

scenarios.description: High flooded area density weighting prioritizing total absolute surface area inundated.
scenarios.assumptions: Exploratory scenario simulating physical water volume response where expansive footprints dictate heavy drainage equipment.
